# Hyperbolic

![Hyperbolic function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/hyperbolic/00_Hyperbolic.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Browse twelve hyperbolic functions and their principal inverses, in the supplied icon order. Every node has one required numeric input x and one output. No angle conversion or analytic Matrix overload.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Hyperbolic**

Parcourir douze fonctions hyperboliques et leurs inverses principales, dans l’ordre des icônes fournies. Chaque nœud possède une entrée numérique x requise et une sortie. Aucune conversion d’angle ni surcharge analytique Matrix.

</details>

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Hyperbolic Sine](../../math/hyperbolic/sinh.md) | Computes the hyperbolic sine of x. Input x; output sinh. Every real x; signed zero is preserved, and sinh(±Infinity)=±Infinity. Example: Sinh(ln(2)) = 0.75. |
| [Hyperbolic Cosine](../../math/hyperbolic/cosh.md) | Computes the hyperbolic cosine of x. Input x; output cosh. Every real x; cosh(±0)=1 and cosh(±Infinity)=+Infinity. Example: Cosh(ln(2)) = 1.25. |
| [Hyperbolic Tangent](../../math/hyperbolic/tanh.md) | Computes the hyperbolic tangent of x. Input x; output tanh. Every real x; signed zero is preserved and tanh(±Infinity)=±1. Large finite inputs may round to ±1. Example: Tanh(ln(2)) = 0.6. |
| [Hyperbolic Secant](../../math/hyperbolic/sech.md) | Computes the reciprocal of the hyperbolic cosine, not its inverse function. Input x; output sech. Every real x; sech(0)=1 and sech(±Infinity)=+0. Example: Sech(ln(2)) = 0.8. |
| [Hyperbolic Cosecant](../../math/hyperbolic/csch.md) | Computes the reciprocal of the hyperbolic sine. Input x; output csch. Real domain x≠0. FROG extends csch(±0)=±Infinity and csch(±Infinity)=±0. Example: Csch(ln(2)) = 4/3. |
| [Hyperbolic Cotangent](../../math/hyperbolic/coth.md) | Computes the reciprocal of the hyperbolic tangent. Input x; output coth. Real domain x≠0. FROG extends coth(±0)=±Infinity; coth(±Infinity)=±1. Example: Coth(ln(2)) = 5/3. |
| [Inverse Hyperbolic Sine](../../math/hyperbolic/asinh.md) | Returns y such that sinh(y)=x, using the principal branch for a complex input. Input x; output arcsinh. Every real x; signed zero is preserved and asinh(±Infinity)=±Infinity. Example: Asinh(0.75) = ln(2). |
| [Inverse Hyperbolic Cosine](../../math/hyperbolic/acosh.md) | Returns the non-negative real y such that cosh(y)=x, or the principal complex result. Input x; output arccosh. Real domain x≥1; x&lt;1 gives NaN. acosh(1)=+0 and acosh(+Infinity)=+Infinity. Example: Acosh(1.25) = ln(2). |
| [Inverse Hyperbolic Tangent](../../math/hyperbolic/atanh.md) | Returns y such that tanh(y)=x, using the principal branch for a complex input. Input x; output arctanh. Finite real results require \|x\|&lt;1. atanh(±1)=±Infinity; \|x\|&gt;1 gives NaN. Signed zero is preserved. Example: Atanh(0.6) = ln(2). |
| [Inverse Hyperbolic Secant](../../math/hyperbolic/asech.md) | Returns the non-negative real y such that sech(y)=x, or the principal complex result. Input x; output arcsech. Finite real domain 0&lt;x≤1. asech(1)=+0; FROG defines asech(+0)=+Infinity and asech(−0)=NaN. Negative x and x&gt;1 give NaN. Example: Asech(0.8) = ln(2). |
| [Inverse Hyperbolic Cosecant](../../math/hyperbolic/acsch.md) | Returns y such that csch(y)=x, using the principal branch for a complex input. Input x; output arccsch. Real domain x≠0, including negative inputs. FROG extends acsch(±0)=±Infinity and acsch(±Infinity)=±0. Example: Acsch(4/3) = ln(2). |
| [Inverse Hyperbolic Cotangent](../../math/hyperbolic/acoth.md) | Returns y such that coth(y)=x, using the principal branch for a complex input. Input x; output arccoth. Finite real domain \|x\|&gt;1. acoth(±1)=±Infinity; \|x\|&lt;1 gives NaN and acoth(±Infinity)=±0. Example: Acoth(5/3) = ln(2). |
